summary.description: Root cause and what the change does. When nothing was changed, the reason.

changedFiles.description: Advisory only. The engine derives the authoritative changed set from Git.

ownerQuestion.description: Set only when the fix needs a decision the code owner alone can make. Nothing is changed in that case.

behaviourChange.description: Observable behaviour the fix alters beyond closing the finding, including any input the code now turns away.

refusal.description: Set when the dispatch was malformed or asked for something other than fixing the named finding.
